review_attribution.prompt_scope: Executor supplied expected values and interpretations as well as paths. They were treated as untrusted assertions; this was not a blinded path-only prompt.

scope: Result integrity only. No project source/plan/result edits, neural execution, PyTorch import, GPU/SSH queries, other-job inspection or full training-algorithm reaudit. HANDOFF and later human-facing result documents were not inputs.

A_ground_truth_provenance.details: The frozen manifest supplies uncensored dataset init.txt boxes. Its hash matches the training plan and full training execution plan; repository train 882/dev 97 split membership and ordering match. No model output is used as a target. Original dataset annotation files were not recaptured in this audit.

B_score_normalization.details: Raw original-image intersection-over-union uses prediction/target union only. Coverage uses target area. No prediction-dependent score rescaling. All comparisons use every scheduled valid state; summary means weight states equally.

C_result_existence_and_execution.details: Original native config and COMPLETE byte hashes bind the public collector report and private comparison bytes. Full B completion precedes actual read-only M0, which precedes formal execution. M0 is 10 tracks/2 states/36 comparisons, 265 unchanged state tensors, zero updates/backward and seven strict-reload fields. Formal is 20 sequences/8854 tracks/1752 states/31536 comparisons, 265 unchanged state tensors and zero updates/backward. Native tensor/remote-state assertions are not independent local replays.

D_called_functions_and_control_flow.details: The executed main path calls diagnose and aggregate; every state has six regions and three contents. Snapshotted helpers parse, content manipulation changes only auxiliary channels, and the reader consumes only those auxiliary channels. Factual tracker receives image only after first-frame initialization, and counterfactual outputs never assign tracker state.

E_scope_and_fairness.details: Within-region TRUE/ZERO/SHIFT comparisons are paired at fixed geometry, templates, cached primary and auxiliary token budget. Local queries use 193 tokens and wide queries 385, so cross-width comparisons are not equal-budget experiments. GT-centred controls retain a correct-location prior. Only the current auxiliary search pixels are intervened on; auxiliary templates, cheap previews, query coordinates and learned priors remain. The reference heavy execution is primary-only but its cheap scheduling sees both modalities. This is one seed and one train 20 visited-state distribution, not official tracking metrics or generalization.

F_evaluation_type.design: Train-only controlled auxiliary-search-content diagnostic with two oracle-location controls, conditioned on a primary-only heavy-execution reference rollout.

warnings.details: The original final tool result has actual exit 0 and its stdout exactly matches the public completion summary. It was supplied from the parent persistent tool-result store. Separate SSH stdout/stderr transport receipts were not retained. The parent CPU analysis actual exit 0 is transcript-only; this review independently recomputed its output with retained local receipts. No independent SSH or neural replay was performed.

warnings.reason: Independent reconstruction has a defined boundary.
warnings.details: All query executed-box IoUs, query GT coverage, query-centre flags and oracle query coordinates were independently reconstructed. The main executed boxes and main search geometries are absent from the comparison data: main IoUs and the 239 main-centre-outside labels remain native-derived. Cross-content geometry/tokens/main scalar identity is independently checked; primary pixel/feature identity and factual-primary equality rely on the source assertions and completed native run. Learned query coordinates were not regenerated from model features.

docs/GLOBAL_CONTENT_PROTOCOL.md:3 still reads SOURCE_PENDING and formal execution NOT_RUN. It is a historical frozen protocol statement; the hash-bound completion evidence proves this diagnostic finished. The protocol was not edited during this audit.

Requested Astra/max routing has no independent runtime attestation. The prompt contained executor summaries; the reviewer read primary artifacts and wrote independent checks. This is same-family/provisional review, not blinded or cross-family acceptance.

discovery_issues.details: Initial rg search included absent configs/tests directories.
A batched discovery read included an absent opportunity-plan name. The correct observed filename was then read; the inner rg exit code was not captured separately.

claim_boundaries: Supported: the full scheduled train 20 reference population and all six within-region TRUE/ZERO/SHIFT content comparisons.
Supported conditionally: the current auxiliary search content contributes at fixed inputs in the observed states; an advantage is not universal across regions or states.
GT_CENTER controls retain oracle coordinates. Their results do not establish deployable proposal localization.
ZERO_AUX retains auxiliary templates, cheap previews, geometry and learned priors. It does not remove all auxiliary information.
SHIFT_AUX is half-width/half-height cyclic displacement, not an independent distractor identity or a natural sensor failure.
The 239 outside-main subgroup is native-labelled. Its query coverage is independently recomputed conditional on that label.
No paired improvement claim between A and B reference rollouts with different visited states.
No PR/NPR/SR, trajectory upper bound, stability, p-value, latency, all-three-innovation completion or final deployment performance claim.
publication_policy: Only safe aggregates, code/report references and hashes are public. Raw annotations, comparison records, coordinates, private paths and input snapshots remain private.
